h1: Stay With Nimman — A Design Stay in the Heart of Nimman with Rooftop Pools on a Budget
intro: Picture this: a modern stay on Siri Mangkalajarn Road, a few minutes' walk from One Nimman and MAYA, surrounded by the cafes, galleries and restaurants of the Nimman area — Stay With Nimman is the choice many travellers pick for a central spot in Chiang Mai's hippest quarter, spacious rooms and rooftop pools at a price that's easy on the wallet · 133 rooms with two rooftop pools, a gym and a spa, from approx. THB 1,200/night.

body.html: Stay With Nimman positions itself as a design-led stay in the Nimmanhaemin area — the part of Chiang Mai best known for its cafes, galleries and hip restaurants · What makes it so popular is its central Nimman location, a few minutes' walk from One Nimman and MAYA Lifestyle Shopping Center, with massage shops, coffee houses and restaurants all around · The building is clean and modern, a world away from the old-school hostel image many travellers expect.

There are 133 rooms, from Superior and Deluxe up to a Signature Suite and family rooms · Guests often note that rooms are larger than expected at this price, with comfortable beds, a work desk, a mini-bar and large windows — some with city or mountain views · It suits both holidaymakers and workation travellers settling in to work from the Nimman cafes · To be honest, a few reviews mention inconsistent cleanliness in some rooms and fiddly bathroom lighting.
"The room was bigger than I expected, the rooftop pool has a great city view, and One Nimman is just steps away. At this price in this location, it's good value."

The most talked-about feature is the rooftop pool, with views over the city and Doi Suthep on a clear day · There are two pools here, including a children's pool, plus a gym, a spa offering massages and body scrubs, a restaurant, a cafe and a bar · Breakfast draws frequent praise in reviews, with many saying the spread is varied and tastes better than the price suggests — a set of facilities far more complete than most stays at this price point.

Service is something most reviews praise · Many say the staff are warm and helpful — sorting out cars, recommending restaurants, and sometimes upgrading rooms for free · One breakfast server in particular gets singled out for praise · A few reviews note slower responsiveness when busy, or unexpected charges such as a lost key-card fee · Overall it's a stay that delivers service above its price.

The honest trade-off from real guest reviews is noise from bars and the street in the Nimman area at night, especially on lower floors and street-facing rooms · Soundproofing between rooms isn't as thick as it could be, and light sleepers report it disturbs their sleep · Some reviews also mention a sewage smell outside in places · If you're sensitive to noise, request a high, interior room in advance.

The overall score sits around 8.9 — Trip.com gives 9.0 from 1,562 reviews and TripAdvisor 4.3/5, ranking #117 of 540 hotels in Chiang Mai · Its highest-scoring points are location, value and the rooftop pool, while most complaints come down to noise and cleanliness in some rooms · Those numbers reflect that most guests are very happy with what they get at this price.

The verdict from real guest reviews: Stay With Nimman is best for travellers who want to stay in the heart of the Nimman area, with a spacious design room and a rooftop pool, at a budget price · If you like cafe-hopping, shopping at One Nimman, getting work done, or simply want a good-looking stay without paying a premium, this delivers · But if you're a light sleeper, sensitive to noise, or after total quiet, request a high floor or choose a quieter area.

honestSummary: Stay With Nimman is the best budget choice for travellers who want a heart-of-Nimman location, a spacious design room and a rooftop pool, at an affordable price · The honest trade-offs are noise from the Nimman area at night, thin soundproofing between rooms, and cleanliness that can be inconsistent in some rooms.
honestChecks: If you're a light sleeper sensitive to noise — street-facing and lower-floor rooms hear bars and traffic at night → request a high, interior room away from the street, or choose a stay in a quieter area.
If you expect a rock-bottom hostel vibe — this is an affordable design-led 4-star-style stay, not a bunk-bed dorm → if you want the cheapest shared dorm, look at an actual dorm hostel.
If you're wary of hidden charges — some reviews mention a lost key-card fee and add-ons → confirm the charges and conditions clearly at check-in.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Stay With Nimman Chiang Mai

faq.q: Where is Stay With Nimman, and what's nearby?
faq.a: Stay With Nimman is at 8/8 Siri Mangkalajarn Road, Suthep, Mueang Chiang Mai, in the heart of the Nimmanhaemin area · It's about a 3-minute walk to Nimmanhaemin Road, 5 minutes to One Nimman and 8 minutes to MAYA · Tha Phae Gate and the Night Bazaar are about 10–12 minutes by car, and Chiang Mai Airport about 12 minutes by car.

faq.q: How much does Stay With Nimman cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rates start at around THB 1,200/night for a Superior Room · There are also Deluxe King, Premier Twin with a bathtub, and a 35 sqm Signature Suite, with prices rising by size and view · High-season rates climb, so compare several platforms before booking.

faq.q: Who is Stay With Nimman best for?
faq.a: It's a great fit for travellers who want to stay in the heart of Nimman, with a spacious design room and a rooftop pool, at a budget price · Good for couples, solo travellers, groups of friends and workation travellers working from the cafe quarter · It's not the choice for light sleepers sensitive to noise, or those after the cheapest shared dorm.

faq.q: Is Stay With Nimman noisy, and does it have a pool?
faq.a: Because it's in the heart of the Nimman area, there is noise from bars and the street at night, especially on lower floors and street-facing rooms — light sleepers should request a high, interior room · The hotel has two rooftop pools, including a children's pool, plus a gym and a spa, which are standout features in reviews.

faq.q: What are the downsides to know before booking Stay With Nimman?
faq.a: The most common complaints in reviews are noise from the Nimman area at night, thin soundproofing between rooms, and cleanliness that can be inconsistent in some rooms · Some reviews mention a sewage smell outside and extra charges such as a lost key-card fee · If that matters, request a high, interior room and confirm the charges at check-in.

faq.q: How far ahead should I book?
faq.a: For high season (November–February) and the Yi Peng / Loy Krathong festival, rooms fill up fast — book 1–2 months ahead · Other times, 1–2 weeks is usually enough · Every platform offers a free-cancellation option — pick that if your plans aren't firm yet.
